subject: Request: full subprocessor attribute inventory — ZenithPay onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@zenithpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Barker <tbarker@zenithpay.com>, ZenithPay Security <security@zenithpay.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: complete subprocessor attributes for vendor assessment

Hi Marissa,

We're finalizing our security intake for Redwood as part of the ZenithPay vendor onboarding. To close the review the Security and Privacy teams have asked for a consolidated inventory of Redwood's subprocessors and for each one the following attributes:
- legal entity and country
- purpose of processing and data categories processed (PII, metadata, logs)
- whether the subprocessor handles EU data and any cross-border transfers
- retention policy and deletion SOP reference
- encryption at rest/in transit details and KMS/HSM usage
- personnel access controls and role-based access description
- last audit date and audit evidence (SOC/ISO/etc) if available

Can you provide a single artifact with those columns, or point me to an internal doc? We also need any statements about subprocessor change notification timelines and SLA for data exports.

Appreciate a response by EOD Friday 11/20 — we're trying to keep the onboarding on schedule.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Vendor Risk Lead, ZenithPay

[ZenithPay internal: attaching vendor intake checklist]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@zenithpay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete subprocessor attributes for vendor assessment

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a consolidated CSV that contains the attributes you outlined. I’ve attached a Q3 snapshot and included a short summary below.

Attachment: redwood_subprocessors_q32026.csv (columns: name, legal_entity, country, purpose, data_categories, eu_processing, cross_border, retention_policy, kms_used, personnel_access, last_audit)
Attachment: access_matrix_redwood.tsv (roles and access levels mapped to subprocessors)

Quick summary:
- We maintain a central subprocessor registry and notify customers 30 days in advance for additions that affect data flows (standard in our DPA).
- For KMS/HSM-backed services we use either our managed cloud KMS with CMKs or partner HSMs depending on the deployment; per-request evidence can be provided (see evidence_kms_hsm_summary.pdf attached).
- For EU data, most subprocessors operate under EU contracts or SCCs; cross-border transfers are explicitly tracked in the registry.

Can you confirm which attributes you want inline in the CSV vs separate evidence (e.g., full SOC reports)? If ZenithPay needs SOC/ISO artifacts we can share them under an NDA/secure portal or provide attestations.

I propose a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the CSV and any rows that need clarifications — I’ve proposed times in the HubSpot link below.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll upload the full inventory (attached) and a short KMS/HSM summary.
- If needed, we can produce an exports playbook describing deletion windows and request procedures for data subject requests.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-19T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: complete subprocessor attributes for vendor assessment

Thanks Marissa — received the CSV and summary. A couple of quick clarifications from Security:
- For subprocessors that use Redwood-managed KMS, can you confirm whether customer keys are customer-controlled CMKs or service-owned keys? We need to map key ownership to our Key Management policy.
- For any subprocessors located outside the EU that process ZenithPay EU data, please list the legal basis and the transfer mechanism (SCCs, adequacy, or documented exceptions).
- For the access matrix, can you highlight any subprocessors with privileged console access to production data?

We’re OK with a secure link for SOC attestation if you can provide a time-limited download. Also — can you provide the standard subprocessor change notification clause from your DPA (we want the exact language to include in our procurement review)?

If you can surface those by EOD tomorrow that would keep us on the procurement timeline.

Regards,
Elena

Elena — quick follow-up with the specific items you asked for:

1) Key ownership: For hosted Redwood API customers we support customer-managed keys (CMKs) for dedicated/private deployments; by default hosted customers use service-managed keys. Where CMK is used, the registry notes the KMS provider and whether the CMK is under customer project/account or Redwood-managed tenancy. See row "kms_used" in the CSV for each subprocessor.

2) Cross-border transfers: I added a new column "transfer_mechanism" in the attached CSV and flagged subprocessors that process EU-origin data. Transfer mechanisms are annotated as SCC, adequacy, or contractually restricted.

3) Privileged access: In access_matrix_redwood.tsv I added a "privileged_console" boolean and listed the incidents of direct console access; subprocessors with privileged production access are highlighted (3 entries).

4) DPA language: Extract from our standard DPA: "Supplier will notify Customer of additions or material changes to Subprocessors at least thirty (30) days prior to such change, and Customer may object to any new Subprocessor on reasonable grounds related to data protection; absent objection the Supplier may proceed." If ZenithPay requires a longer notice window or contractual restriction on specific vendors we can escalate to legal.

5) SOC evidence: I can provide time-limited download links to our SOC/ISO evidence via the secure portal linked below (I’ll request upload and share a link with expiry).

Links & artifacts:
- HubSpot deal & proposed meeting times: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-12987
- Secure evidence upload portal (internal request submitted)
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-subproc-onboarding

If that addresses your asks I’ll mark the onboarding checklist as complete and schedule a 30m sync with our Privacy/Security SMEs to answer any nuance.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
